lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਬੀਓ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan moh ar lobh vikaaraa beeo cheet na ghaalio ||
lines.translation: Pride, emotional attachment, greed and corruption are gone; I have not placed anything else, other than the Lord, within my consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਜੇ ਲਾਦਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam ratan gunaa har banaje laad vakhar lai chaalio ||1||
lines.translation: I have purchased the jewel of the Naam and the Glorious Praises of the Lord; loading this merchandise, I have set out on my journey. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਓੜਕਿ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak kee oRak nibahee preet ||
lines.translation: The love which the Lord's servant feels for the Lord lasts forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਚਲਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat saahib sevio apanaa chalate raakhio cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In my life, I served my Lord and Master, and as I depart, I keep Him enshrined in my consciousness. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਕੀਨੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee aagiaa keenee thaakur tis te mukh nahee morio ||
lines.translation: I have not turned my face away from my Lord and Master's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਰਖਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਕਉ ਦਉਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d rakhio grih bheetar uth uaahoo kau daurio ||2||
lines.translation: He fills my household with celestial peace and bliss; if He asks me to leave, I leave at once. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਖ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagiaa mahi bhookh soee kar sookhaa sog harakh nahee jaanio ||
lines.translation: When I am under the Lord's Command, I find even hunger pleasurable; I know no difference between sorrow and joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਮਾਥੈ ਲੇ ਮਾਨਿਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo hukam bhaio saahib kaa so maathai le maanio ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever the Command of my Lord and Master is, I bow my forehead and accept it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਵਰੇ ਹਲਤ ਪਲਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio kripaal thaakur sevak kau savare halat palaataa ||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master has become merciful to His servant; He has embellished both this world and the next.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਓਹੁ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n sevak saphal ohu aaiaa jin naanak khasam pachhaataa ||4||5||
lines.translation: Blessed is that servant, and fruitful is his birth; O Nanak, he realizes his Lord and Master. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਲਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khuliaa karam kripaa bhaee thaakur keeratan har har gaaee ||
lines.translation: Good karma has dawned for me - my Lord and Master has become merciful. I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sram thaakaa paae bisraamaa mit gaee sagalee dhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: My struggle is ended; I have found peace and tranquility. All my wanderings have ceased. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mohi jeevan padavee paaee ||
lines.translation: Now, I have obtained the state of eternal life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: cheet aaio man purakh bidhaataa sa(n)tan kee saranaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has come into my conscious mind; I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਨਿਵਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu nivaare nivare sagal bairaaee ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are eradicated; all my enemies are eliminated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਜਰੁ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਭਇਓ ਦੂਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sad hajoor haajar hai naajar katahi na bhaio dooraaee ||2||
lines.translation: He is always ever-present, here and now, watching over me; He is never far away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh seetal saradhaa sabh pooree hoe sa(n)t sahaaee ||
lines.translation: In peace and cool tranquility, my faith has been totally fulfilled; the Saints are my Helpers and Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paavan patit keee khin bheetar mahimaa kathan na jaaee ||3||
lines.translation: He has purified the sinners in an instant; I cannot express His Glorious Praises. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਖੋਏ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae sagal bhai khoe gobid charan otaaee ||
lines.translation: I have become fearless; all fear has departed. The feet of the Lord of the Universe are my only Shelter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jas gaavai thaakur kaa rain dinas liv laaee ||4||6||
lines.translation: Nanak sings the Praises of his Lord and Master; night and day, he is lovingly focused on Him. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo samarath sarab gun naaik tis kau kabahu na gaavas re ||
lines.translation: He is all-powerful, the Master of all virtues, but you never sing of Him!

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਉਆ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chhod jaai khin bheetar taa kau uaa kau phir phir dhaavas re ||1||
lines.translation: You shall have to leave all this in an instant, but again and again, you chase after it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਸਮਾਰਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: apune prabh kau kiu na samaaras re ||
lines.translation: Why do you not contemplate your God?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਜਾਰਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bairee sa(n)g ra(n)g ras rachiaa tis siu jeearaa jaaras re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are entangled in association with your enemies, and the enjoyment of pleasures; your soul is burning up with them! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ ਜਮੁ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai naam suniai jam chhodai taa kee saran na paavas re ||
lines.translation: Hearing His Name, the Messenger of Death will release you, and yet, you do not enter His Sanctuary!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਿਆਲ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਟਿਕਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaadh dei siaal bapure kau taa kee ot tikaavas re ||2||
lines.translation: Turn out this wretched jackal, and seek the Shelter of that God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਭਵ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa jaas sunat bhav tareeai taa siu ra(n)g na laavas re ||
lines.translation: Praising Him, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and yet, you have not fallen in love with Him!

lines.gurmukhi: ਥੋਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਟਕਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: thoree baat alap supane kee bahur bahur atakaavas re ||3||
lines.translation: This meager, short-lived dream, this thing - you are engrossed in it, over and over again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio prasaad kripaa nidh thaakur sa(n)tasa(n)g pat paaee ||
lines.translation: When our Lord and Master, the ocean of mercy, grants His Grace, one finds honor in the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak trai gun bhram chhootaa jau prabh bhae sahaaee ||4||7||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am rid of the illusion of the three-phased Maya, when God becomes my help and support. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਦੁਲਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai tis te kahaa dulaario ||
lines.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; what can anyone hide from Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਝਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hasat paav jhare khin bheetar agan sa(n)g lai jaario ||1||
lines.translation: Your hands and feet will fall off in an instant, when you are burnt in the fire. ||1||
